shortDescription: CTERA-Networks Portal user configuration and management

options.name: company
options.description: The name of the company of the user

options.name: email
options.description: The e-mail address of the user

options.name: first_name
options.description: The first name of the user

options.name: last_name
options.description: The first name of the user

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the user Required when C(state=present) and the user does not exist If the user exists, the new password will be set

options.name: password_change
options.description: Whether to enforce a password change Pass a string in the format of '%Y-%m-%d' for a specific date, integer for days from creation, or True for immediate , defaults to False.

options.name: role
options.description: User role of the new user

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified user should exist or not.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of the tenant. For Global Admin operations set to "$admin" Use default if not provided. Do not set for initialization operations

options.name: update_password
options.description: If True, and user exists, the password will be updated
